# Third-party attribution

`evoloop.py` and `ctrbl_rule.py` are unmodified copies from Luis M. Antunes,
CellPyLib, commit `743e936d48f8520f6f4ac652570ac7bb46414189`.
https://github.com/lantunes/cellpylib (Apache License 2.0, LICENSE.txt).
CellPyLib implements Hiroki Sayama's evoloop rules and species-13 seed.
The minimal `ca_functions.py` base class is our replacement, not upstream code.
No Sayama simulator source, seed catalogue, papers, or website artwork is redistributed.
